caution_findings.note: DBAASP labels the Proteus mirabilis PEDUTI-971 1.0-1.25 μM value as MIC, while primary Table 1 supports that value in the MBC column; final activity uses the primary MBC row and the database row remains source_conflict.

The current paper confirms full-length RNase 7 construct context but does not print the exact amino-acid sequence; the merged sequence row was checked but not promoted to exact primary-source sequence verification from this paper alone.

The paper references supplemental figures, but no supplementary original/PDF/XLSX files are present in the local packet or OA package. The source text supports the qualitative toxicity/hemolysis conclusions, so no unsupported figure-only exact values were fabricated.
Membrane disruption is direct-assay supported by AFM and Live/Dead/confocal experiments; no molecular receptor or biochemical target is claimed.
